verdict.rationale: Bitbucket Pipelines offers deployment environments and testing policies [bitbucket-docs-8], and environment-level permissions can restrict who deploys to production [bitbucket-docs-9]. That implies tests can run against non-production environments, but the evidence never describes a dedicated sandbox for safe testing. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test workspace/account offering, documentation on isolating test runs from production data, agent-oriented sandbox workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
